d:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi's appeal to Indians to reduce gold purchases has triggered a fresh political debate. The Chamber of Trade and Industry (CTI) has written to the PM, claiming that his advice helped jewellers and investors avoid potential losses as gold prices fell. According to CTI, the price of one kilogram of gold dropped from around ₹1.90 crore to ₹1.25 crore. The development has also reignited the Congress-BJP political exchange over the PM's appeal, which Congress leaders had earlier criticised as a threat to the jewellery sector.
